title: Spaghetti Strap Corset Top & Wrap Front Balloon Wide Leg Pants 2-Piece Set
body_html:
Product Details

Top (Camisole Corset)

  • Neckline: Sweetheart bustier neckline, ultra-thin adjustable spaghetti shoulder straps
  • Placket: Full front vertical hook-and-eye closure, cropped ultra-short length to expose midriff
  • Silhouette: Structured corset fit with subtle bust ruching, cinches waist to accentuate curves
  • Fabric: Crisp lightweight cotton poplin, slight structured hold to maintain bust shape

Bottom (Wide Leg Trousers)

  • Waist: High-rise elastic drawstring waistband for adjustable fit
  • Front Design: Double overlapping wrap folded panel detail at fly, layered draped visual effect
  • Silhouette: Oversized balloon baggy wide leg, loose voluminous thigh, floor-length hem that can be cuffed
  • Pockets: Hidden side slash functional pockets Style Positioning Sweet y2k casual / Soft girl streetwear / Daily pastel coordinate / Café & shopping matching set

Fabric & Thickness

Lightweight crisp cotton poplin, breathable wrinkle-resistant fabric, ideal for spring and summer.

Applicable Scenarios

City shopping, coffee dates, weekend outings, street fashion shooting, amusement park trips.

Fit Feature

Fitted cropped corset top balances the oversized balloon wide leg pants, creates sharp upper-lower proportion contrast; drawstring waist adapts to different waist sizes.

Size Chart

Note

  1. Crisp cotton poplin with no stretch on the corset top; pants waist has elastic drawstring for flexibility, 2~3cm manual measuring error is normal.
  2. Coordinated bubble pink monochrome design, front hook corset + wrap pant panel are the core design highlights.
  3. Matching reference: black platform slide sandals, mini white shoulder bags, delicate silver layered necklaces.
  4. Separable wearing design: corset top can pair with denim shorts; wide leg pants can match plain white tees for separate daily styling.

Packing List

Cami*1 + Pants *1
